CA.rationale: A content entry (red coordinates) and a processing-origin entry (command_estimate) are both present for the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue coordinates), a presentation/organization descriptor (origin), and distinct content vs origin entries co-occur for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: An explicit processing-origin (command_estimate/feedback_through) is bound to a specific candidate content entry, linking a processing condition to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Many entries explicitly identify content (red/blue) with coordinate attributes across current and candidate records.

D.rationale: For the same referent the report separately lists the identified content (coordinates) and a distinct organization/access status (origin), meeting the differentiation requirement.

O.rationale: Entries include explicit origin/organization descriptors that state how contents are presented or derived (copied_prior_record, native_conditional_record, etc.).
